mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) compresses discount rates and boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and 5d returns are negative in > 60% of instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly rise in CPIAUCSL exceeding 0.3% signals accelerating inflation, prompting central bank tightening and reducing equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL rises > 0.3% in 1 month but 20d returns are positive in > 60% of instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When employment growth (PAYEMS) accelerates above 100k per month and unemployment (UNRATE) falls below 5.0%, the labor market tightens, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS > 100000 and UNRATE < 5.0 but 20d returns are negative in > 60% of instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes (HOUST > 1050 and GDPC1 annualized growth > 2%), the S&P 500 is prone to overvaluation and negative forward returns due to impending monetary tightening.
failure_condition: HOUST > 1050 and GDPC1 annualized growth > 2% but 60d returns are positive in > 60% of instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in INDPRO below 105.0 signals weakening industrial activity, prompting equity sell-offs and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 105.0 but 20d returns are positive in > 60% of instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is low (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) and inflation is accelerating (CPIAUCSL > 238.0), the market anticipates a policy pivot, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and CPIAUCSL > 238.0 but 20d returns are negative in > 60% of instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 5.0%) signals a tight labor market, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE < 5.0% and 20d returns are negative in > 60% of instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1000.0 signals weakening consumer demand and economic slowdown, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST < 1000.0 but 20d returns are positive in > 60% of instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
